svg.title: Figure 3-3 · CAN interface map
svg.desc: CAN interface map of LD-SDA from WP-C-01 §3.4. Bus 0 transmitted by the item (IF-01): 0x2E4 STEERING_LKA to EPS; 0x191 STEERING_LTA to EPS; 0x343 ACC_CONTROL to ECM/PCM and brake actuator via the PCM ACC interface; 0x412 LKAS_HUD to instrument cluster; 0x1D2 PCM_CRUISE to ECM/PCM and brake actuator via the PCM ACC interface; 0x283 PRE_COLLISION to stock PCS receivers; 0x750 radar diagnostic to forward radar, diagnostic address. Received (IF-02): 0xAA WHEEL_SPEEDS; 0x260 STEER_TORQUE_SENSOR; 0x1D2 PCM_CRUISE; 0x226 BRAKE_MODULE; 0x262 EPS_STATUS (reference build only); 0x1D3 PCM_CRUISE_2 (reference build only); 0x180 radar tracks; the radar tracks on bus 1 are read by the host only. Bus 2 (IF-03): camera frames are forwarded to the car except 0x2E4, 0x191, 0x412, 0x343, which the item replaces. For each message the panda safety mode check is shown: TX whitelist, relay check and content limits; RX rate and checksum, with 0x262 and 0x1D3 checked only in the reference build. Nothing is shown as verified.

Checks as implemented in toyota.h at the opendbc pin; none is verified on the reference vehicle (the RX rates of 0x262 and 0x1D3 are to be measured, WP-S-05 OI-7). Messages, names and counterparts: §3.4 table.
Checks: WP-S-02, WP-S-05 §5, WP-W-05, WP-W-09, DN-01, each named in the generator. Trace pills: requirement, AoU or function the message serves.
